special_traits.name: Divine Awareness
special_traits.description: The solar knows if it hears a lie.

special_traits.name: Exalted Restoration
special_traits.description:
If the solar dies outside Mount
Celestia, its body disappears, and it gains a new body instantly, reviving with all its Hit Points somewhere in Mount Celestia.

special_traits.name: Legendary Resistance (4/Day)
special_traits.description:
If the solar fails a saving
throw, it can choose to succeed instead.

special_traits.name: Magic Resistance
special_traits.description:
The solar has Advantage on saving
throws against spells and other magical effects.

actions.name: Multiattack
actions.description:
The solar makes two Flying Sword attacks.
It can replace one attack with a use of Slaying Bow.
